steps.title: Face the stem to the 40 mm height
steps.caption: Face the stem to the 40 mm height, with the 2 in face mill.

steps.title: Rough and finish the stem's sides, the steps at 20 and 27 mm, the flange's underside at 30 mm and the rest of both ends
steps.caption: Rough and finish the stem's sides, the steps at 20 and 27 mm, the flange's underside at 30 mm and the rest of both ends, with the 1/2 in end mill.

steps.title: Mill the R10 between the stem and the flange
steps.caption: Mill the R10 between the stem and the flange, with the 1/4 in ball end mill.

steps.title: Drill the flat-bottomed Ø11 up the stem, 30 deep, to meet the Ø6.6
steps.caption: Drill the flat-bottomed Ø11 up the stem, 30 deep, to meet the Ø6.6, with the 11 mm drill.

steps.title: Blow off the chips and unload
steps.caption: Open the door, blow the chips off, loosen the vise and lift the part out.

steps.title: Clean the vise and set the stop
steps.caption: Blow out the 6 in vise and wipe the jaws and its floor, then set the stop.

steps.title: Load the part
steps.caption: Set the part in the 6 in vise, on its edge, the stem's side up, on the vise floor and a stop.

steps.title: Seat it and tighten the vise
steps.caption: Close the jaw until it touches, tap the part down, then tighten the handle.

steps.title: Check it's square
steps.caption: Sweep the indicator up its side: the needle should stay put.

steps.title: Find X and Y
steps.caption: Set G54 X at the top (probe) and Y at the end (probe).

steps.title: Set Z
steps.caption: Set G54 Z at the stem's side (probe).

steps.title: Load the tools
steps.caption: Load the 1/2 in spot drill, the 6.5 mm drill, the 3.3 mm drill, the M4 tap into the carousel.

steps.title: Close the door and start the cycle
steps.caption: Close the door, check the program is Op 30: side of the stem, and press Cycle Start.

steps.title: Spot the four holes and countersink the two clearance holes Ø9.5 x 90°
steps.caption: Spot the four holes and countersink the two clearance holes Ø9.5 x 90°, with the 1/2 in spot drill.

steps.title: Drill 2X Ø6.5 through the stem
steps.caption: Drill 2X Ø6.5 through the stem, with the 6.5 mm drill.

steps.title: Drill 2X Ø3.3 through the stem
steps.caption: Drill 2X Ø3.3 through the stem, with the 3.3 mm drill.

steps.title: Tap both M4x0.7-6H through
steps.caption: Tap both M4x0.7-6H through, with the M4 tap.

steps.title: Blow off the chips and unload
steps.caption: Open the door, blow the chips off, loosen the vise and lift the part out.

steps.title: Deburr every edge
steps.caption: Deburr every edge, breaking each sharp corner 0.2 x 45° (note 1) with a hooked blade drawn along it, and clean the M4 threads' exits.

steps.title: Send it out for zinc plating
steps.caption: Tag the part for zinc and trivalent chromate with the two Ø10 H7 bores and the M4 threads masked, so the plating can't close them, and set it on the outside-process rack's coating shelf for the vendor.

steps.title: Zinc plate with a trivalent chromate
steps.caption: Zinc plate with a trivalent chromate, all over but the masked bores and threads, by the outside vendor.

steps.title: Check the bores, threads and plating
steps.caption: Check the 75, 49 and 40 sizes with the calipers, the Ø10.000 H7 counterbores with gauge pins, the M4 threads with a go/no-go gauge, and the plating all over.
